hero_claim.headline_en: Visibly Corrects Hyperpigmentation with Tranexamic Acid & Niacinamide Synergy
hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: Tranexamic acid and niacinamide are well-established ingredients for addressing hyperpigmentation. Studies show tranexamic acid's efficacy in melasma treatment (PMID:42105927, 42166116) and niacinamide's role in inhibiting melanosome transfer and improving skin barrier function. Their combined use is supported by research demonstrating enhanced depigmenting effects (PMID:42406361).
hero_claim.scientific_basis_kr: 트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드는 색소침착 개선에 효과적인 성분으로 잘 알려져 있습니다. 트라넥삼산은 멜라즈마 치료에 효과적이며(PMID:42105927, 42166116), 나이아신아마이드는 멜라닌 소포 이동 억제 및 피부 장벽 개선에 기여합니다. 이 두 성분의 병용은 색소 침착 개선 효과를 증대시키는 것으로 연구되었습니다(PMID:42406361).

rtb_points.point_en: Tranexamic acid helps manage melasma and hyperpigmentation by targeting melanin production pathways.
rtb_points.point_kr: 트라넥삼산은 멜라닌 생성 경로를 케어하여 멜라즈마 및 색소침착 관리에 도움을 줍니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID:42105927, Clinical Considerations for Oral Tranexamic Acid in Melasma Treatment.

rtb_points.point_en: Niacinamide supports skin brightening by inhibiting melanosome transfer to keratinocytes.
rtb_points.point_kr: 나이아신아마이드는 각질형성세포로의 멜라닌 소포 이동을 억제하여 피부톤을 밝게 가꾸는 데 기여합니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID:42406361, Efficacy and Tolerability of a Topical Pigment-Correcting Serum in Melasma and Postinflammatory Hyperpigmentation.

rtb_points.point_en: The combination of tranexamic acid and niacinamide shows synergistic effects in improving hyperpigmentation.
rtb_points.point_kr: 트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드의 조합은 색소침착 개선에 시너지 효과를 나타냅니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID:42406361, Efficacy and Tolerability of a Topical Pigment-Correcting Serum in Melasma and Postinflammatory Hyperpigmentation.

rtb_points.point_en: Tranexamic acid offers anti-aging benefits by protecting dermal fibroblasts from senescence.
rtb_points.point_kr: 트라넥삼산은 진피 섬유아세포를 노화로부터 보호하여 안티에이징 효과를 제공합니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID:42059427, Tranexamic acid protects human dermal fibroblasts from D-galactose-induced senescence via the GPR30/MAPK pathway.

tech_story.headline_en: Advanced Formulation Enhances Topical Delivery of Key Actives
tech_story.headline_kr: 핵심 유효성분의 피부 전달력을 높이는 포뮬러 기술
supporting_facts_en: Engineered delivery systems improve topical performance of tranexamic acid (PMID:42293393).
Formulations combining lotus sprout extract, tranexamic acid, and niacinamide demonstrate efficacy in pigment correction (PMID:42406361).
supporting_facts_kr: 트라넥삼산의 국소 적용 성능을 향상시키는 전달 시스템이 개발되었습니다(PMID:42293393).
연꽃 새싹 추출물, 트라넥삼산, 나이아신아마이드 복합 포뮬러는 색소 침착 개선에 효과를 보였습니다(PMID:42406361).

claims.north_america_angle_en: Leverages well-researched ingredients like Tranexamic Acid and Niacinamide, recognized for their efficacy in addressing hyperpigmentation concerns prevalent in North American markets.
